learning_outcomes.title: Tests for parallelograms
learning_outcomes.statement: Recognize the conditions that ensure a quadrilateral is a parallelogram.
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Sufficient tests include both pairs of opposite sides congruent, both pairs of opposite angles congruent, diagonals bisecting each other, or one pair of opposite sides both parallel and congruent.
